title: SPLIT placement: put each stage object where the frozen key frames put it, and a mint block stamp
goal:
Claude rendered Thursday's cut on the SPLIT layout (merged from ve-thu-5-split-layout-v2) and it does not match the frozen face-with-proof key frames (fixtures/ve/design-lock/face-with-proof/), because SPLIT hands every object the whole stage: the notification bubble sits under the header, cut off; the NO SPENDING / NO SENDING block stamps draw their 30 px text in a 828 px box, so it reads tiny, and in the series colour instead of mint; the cursor buddy lands on top of the slabs. The approved mocks (apps/renderer/src/engine/mocks/face-with-proof.tsx) place each device with its own slot box, an offset and a scale (the Still helper). Give the real composition the same placement.

1. An object on a SPLIT beat may carry `place: { left, top, width, height, scale }` in its params, in stage coordinates before the stage scale (FWP_STAGE_SCALE), with the meaning of the mocks' Still helper: the device receives box { left: 0, top: 0, width, height } and is drawn inside a wrapper at (left, top) with transform scale(scale), top-left origin. FormatMaster removes `place` from the params before the device sees them, so every device schema stays strict and unchanged. An object with no `place` keeps today's behaviour (the whole stage). `place` on a non-SPLIT beat is an error naming the object.
2. The stamp device gets an optional `paint: 'channel' | 'mint'` param (default 'channel', today's look): with 'mint' a block stamp fills with tokens.mint, as the Close mock does by binding channel to mint.
3. Export the mocks' placements as one table, FWP_PLACEMENTS (hook: note bubble slot 56,160,920,300 scale 1; buddy slot 0,0,900,1100 at 66,190; close: each block stamp slot 0,0,345,68 scale 2.4 at 72,230 and 72,440; buddy slot 0,0,640,800 at 390,400), and have the mocks read it, so the mocks and a spec that copies it cannot drift.

Tests: `place` is stripped before the device parses its params; a placed object's wrapper has the given left, top and scale and its device the given width and height; an unplaced object is unchanged; `place` on a P1 beat throws naming the object; stamp paint mint fills with tokens.mint and the default is unchanged; the mocks still pass their own tests reading FWP_PLACEMENTS.
contract: Device rules: apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/CONTRACT.md. One clock (useCurrentFrame only in apps/renderer/src/engine/clock.ts). Pure functions of props, no Math.random, no wall clock. Colour roles from tokens, never raw hex. Change no device.
